subject: Request: Rural Library AI Access Pilot — compute credits & trial extension
messages:
From: Elena Ortiz <e.ortiz@northfieldlib.org>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-06T09:12:00-04:00
Subject: Rural branch AI access pilot — compute credits and short extension request

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was excited about the user-facing reading-assistant and the idea of lightweight summarization for our interlibrary-lending docs. I"d like to outline a formal ask so we can move this to our board for approval.

What we're requesting:
- A 6-month pilot covering 10 rural branches (shared public terminals + staff admin)
- An extension of the trial window from 30 days to 180 days so we can do seasonal testing
- An initial credit allocation to cover expected usage (~200k inference tokens / month; see attached estimate)

A little context: we are a consortium of 12 small-town libraries serving largely underconnected communities. Our funder (Tom Nguyen at the Education Foundation — cc'd) is willing to underwrite part of the integration work, but we need Redwood credits to evaluate real-world latency and token economics before committing county funds.

Attached is a short project overview and a usage estimate worksheet. Our timeline is tight: board meets June 10 and we'd like an indication of support by the end of next week if possible.

Let me know what additional info you need.

Best,
Elena Ortiz
Digital Services Director
Northfield County Library Consortium
(e.ortiz@northfieldlib.org)

Attachment: project-overview.pdf
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ortiz <e.ortiz@northfieldlib.org>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.ng@edu-foundation.org>
Date: 2026-05-06T11:04:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Rural branch AI access pilot — compute credits and short extension request

Hi Elena — great to hear the demo resonated, and thanks for the clear ask + timeline. We can definitely explore a pilot structure that preserves performance and keeps costs predictable for your board. A couple quick questions so I can loop in approvals:

1) Data residency & PII: will any patron data be passed to Redwood endpoints, or is the pilot limited to public terminal inputs only? If patron data is in scope we'll need a narrow data handling plan.
2) Evaluation criteria: what are the two metrics you care about most (e.g., median latency under load, accuracy of reference extraction, reduction in staff handling time)?
3) Pilot start date: do you need credits available before June 10 for test installs, or would July 1 kickoff be acceptable if we approve on June 10?

Operationally, we have a standard 30-day free trial for self-serve accounts. For county/foundation pilots we commonly grant promotional credits and extend the trial window for evaluation. I"ll run numbers with my account team and follow up with a concrete pilot proposal.

If you're comfortable, I"ll also share your overview with our field promotions team (Ben Carter) and pricing reviewer (Hannah Schmitt) to get an approval path.

Thanks — I know the board timeline is tight.

— Mina
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com

Hi Mina / Elena — thanks for the clear ask and for including Tom. I reviewed the usage estimate and we can make this work. Approved items:

- Promotional credits: $8,000 in Redwood credits, applied to the consortium account to be consumed during the pilot period (equivalent to the ~200k tokens/month estimate over 6 months under current pricing assumptions).
- Trial extension: we will extend the consortium trial window to 180 days starting from the date the pilot account is provisioned.
- Pilot SOW: I"ve attached a short SOW template and a one-page billing note; Mina, please send to Elena for signature. Once signed we"ll provision credits within 48 hours.

Operational notes:
- Data handling: Elena — if any patron-identifying data will be in scope please reply with the minimal data flow diagram and we will route the account through our privacy review. If not, we can note in the SOW that the pilot uses public-terminal inputs only.
- HubSpot / tracking: I"ve created record DL-2026-091 and linked it to our promos queue.

Elena — glad to help. If you can return a signed SOW by May 18 we can aim to have the pilot live by May 25. Attaching: signed-sow.pdf (SOW template placeholder) and project-overview (for your records).

Best,
Ben Carter
